limits: Unsigned builds and host tests are not physical device proof.
Public inherited signing key does not prove exclusive publisher identity.
The two-phase App648 package passed signature and ARM-model checks. Physical Android interruption is separate from the owner-tested App648 functions.

tested_bootloader.name: Z19
tested_bootloader.qualification: The supplied App648 diagnostics report the reference Z19 boot-region hash and S112 7.3.0. The signed App648 was checked against the bound Z19 public key.

web_host_test_scope: See the public web build evidence for tests, production layouts and the direct downloads.
web_personal_backup_status: Hardware comparisons and export benchmarks are documented in the web evidence.

web_changes.collection_duplicate_comparison: SHA-256 and size of already-read bytes; quick mode not compared; no additional BLE reads
web_changes.local_slot_repair: Optional copy only: supported MF0, matching v8 config/NN.bin, known legacy UID pattern and valid BCC; no device write
web_changes.zip_restore: Inactive exact root OLD/NEW files excluded but retained in archive; pending or unknown transactions block whole import
web_changes.screen_awake: Shared, opt-out wake assistance during file-manager activity and standalone DFU, with visible state and late-release handling.
web_changes.dfu_completion: Final acknowledgement, observed GATT disconnect and browser-requested cleanup are reported separately.
web_changes.name_and_path_errors: German and English explanations for name limits, alias collisions, reserved names and normalization, with affected name and suggested form.
web_changes.sync_changed_after_comparison: German and English messages for changed target and local contents; both stop before device mutation.
web_changes.backup_resume: Shows freshly read and revalidated reused file counts after a completed backup.
web_changes.announcements: Separate Nintendo announcements; excluded from inventory coverage
web_changes.search_preview: Inline public image from the local catalogue ID
web_changes.dfu_package_selection: Carries the selected bundled package into the DFU page.
web_changes.announcement_series_filter: Includes series with announcements only; announcements remain separate from inventory.
web_changes.figure_download_links: Explicit per-ID HTTPS links stored on this browser origin. The name button downloads only after BIN structure and public figure ID match. No Bluetooth session required.
web_changes.web_3_42_0: Home now opens figure import or firmware updates directly. If a source blocks a catalogue download, open it in the browser and check the saved BIN. Download files directly from device search results and export the checked inventory as a CSV for Excel. Illustrated shortcuts distinguish figure and firmware actions; the mobile navigation uses larger labels.
web_changes.web_3_42_1: Six workspaces have distinct accent colours. The illustrated mobile shortcuts open figure import and firmware updates. The connected-device card shows the current directory, entry count, free and total capacity, and a wide teal-to-indigo meter for used storage. Figure import keeps the first click while the view loads. The guide adds Nordic’s desktop Bluetooth DFU option and adapter requirements. README screenshots illustrate simulated device data.
web_changes.web_3_42_2: Compact figure-import and firmware-update shortcuts. The file manager links its source and review ZIPs. Versioned Pages URLs and release documentation provide both archives for web 3.42.2 and 3.42.1.
web_changes.web_3_43_0: Optional restartable folder backups, per-browser catalogue favourites and named filters, JSON link import and export, 180-degree LCD PNG rotation, translated preparation errors, lazy ZIP reader and DE3.67/639 in the LCD test channel.
web_changes.web_3_43_1: The local LittleFS capacity check shows DE3.67 with application counter 639 as the latest verified firmware. This storage profile covers DE3.55 through DE3.67.
web_changes.web_3_44_0: When you open the file manager, it selects the first supported language in your browser’s preference list. Use the language menu to choose a fixed language or return to automatic selection.
web_changes.web_3_45_0: Game compatibility filters, owned figures, dated announcements and a two-way folder comparison. Optional local device nicknames on supported Web Bluetooth sessions.
web_changes.web_3_46_0: Open each published LCD application package in Nordic DFU on Android. Compare two complete backup ZIPs offline.
web_changes.web_3_47_0: Read the first main-menu selection and distinguish it from settings-session input.
web_changes.web_3_48_0: Portable profiles, filtered ZIP comparisons, backup protection, PXMIv2 diagnostics and App644 capacity profile. Correct Windows background shutdown detection.
web_changes.web_3_48_1: App645 firmware selection, signed package identity and three installation paths. Local PFS1 capacity check accepts the exact version and counter.
web_changes.web_3_48_2: Preserve Raw128 metadata when changing read-only flags, preflight reserved paths, clarify backup states, bind App646 and the current public downloads.
web_changes.web_3_48_3: Ship 954 catalogue IDs, all seven Kirby Air Riders under the game filter, German name aliases, and Nintendo sources for both new riders. Firmware name flags still use the 952 App646 IDs.
web_changes.web_3_48_4: The online catalogue check reports missing game notes and write support in the source. Reviewed notes remain available. The remote supports the keyboard and shows which command the device acknowledged. Dragoon and Hydra share a board code, so file inspection lists both possible machines.
web_changes.web_3_49_0: On iPhone the file manager explains catalogue access and Bluetooth options. Comparing a folder again can identify files changed on both sides. Devices running cylin577 firmware have a dedicated PixLink connection option.
web_changes.web_3_50_0: On demand DE LCD display photo during navigation, PNG export, remote STATUS check and session-safe file handoff.
web_changes.web_3_50_1: Select the hardware-tested DE3.74/App647 application as the stable default for compatible LCD devices.
web_changes.web_3_51_0: Responsive directory listing with figure preview and destination-name editing for local uploads.
web_changes.web_3_51_1: Keep the selected figure in view while scrolling long folders in the desktop file manager.
web_changes.web_3_52_0: Stable catalogue ordering and source comparisons, guided hardware observations, mount profile series and load-on-open workspaces.
web_changes.web_3_52_1: Resumable device checks, report imports and comparisons, concurrent draft protection, responsive layout and retryable tool loading.
web_changes.web_3_53_0: Verified reuse of small backup files, optional ZIP compression, phase timings and command counts, local catalogue checks on backup ZIPs, MIFARE Mini slot inspection, UTF-8 name and destination path budgets.
web_changes.battery_voltage: The device power panel and diagnostic overview show the cached voltage in volts to three decimal places, with a German decimal comma and an English decimal point.
web_changes.web_3_55_0: Read the cached three-byte flash ID, associate a confirmed battery label locally per device and record a voluntary battery voltage trace and inspect pixel-aligned LCD photos.
web_changes.web_3_55_1: Recognize the signed DE3.80 application on Z19 and Z20, and distinguish the flash driver capacity table from the mounted storage layout.
web_changes.web_3_55_2: Compare startup scan time, flash reads and bytes read, retain valid PREP and test version labels, keep the observed layout size within the current connection and identify the device-observed DE3.80 LCD preview.

historical_bootloader_bl8.role: Historical corresponding-source BL8 reference; not a current device observation.

web_device_readback_pending_scope: DE3.80/App653 was observed on one LCD in Web 3.55.1. The updated Web 3.55.2 startup comparison and hardware profile still need a real-device session.

system_and_application.role: Two-phase Android package for compatible LCD devices with bootloader counter below 19; follow the storage migration guide for SPIFFS devices.

device_validation_scope: One LCD running App648, with four owner-reported list-return and wake observations in German with resume on, plus confirmation that a known figure was recognized by the Switch. Animation was not recorded. Hardware DFU interruption and NFC endurance remain open.
